Postmarketing surveillance of enalapril. II: Investigation of the potential role of enalapril in deaths with renal failure. The possibility that enalapril might damage renal function was investigated in 1098 deaths recorded in a prescription-event monitoring study. Case notes for 913 patients were examined. In seventy five there was a rise in the urea or creatinine concentration of 50% or more above pretreatment values.
